title: Essential npm Libraries

introduction.heading: Must-Have npm Packages for Node.js & Express Projects
introduction.description: A curated collection of the most useful npm libraries for building modern web applications. Covers authentication, database integration, templating, security, and more. These packages are production-tested and widely used in the Node.js ecosystem.

prerequisites: Basic understanding of Node.js and Express
A project initialized with npm init

steps.title: Install Core Express Packages
steps.description: Essential packages for building Express applications with session management, cookies, and environment variables.
steps.code: npm install express express-session cookie-parser dotenv method-override
steps.note: These are fundamental packages that most Express apps will need.

steps.title: Express - Web Framework
steps.description: Fast, unopinionated, minimalist web framework for Node.js. The foundation for building web servers and APIs.

steps.title: dotenv - Environment Variables
steps.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file into process.env. Essential for keeping secrets out of your code.
steps.note: Create a .env file in your project root and add it to .gitignore!

subSteps.title: Sample .env File
subSteps.description: Example environment variables file. Never commit this to version control!
subSteps.note: Add .env to your .gitignore file. Create .env.example with dummy values for documentation.

steps.title: Install Database Packages
steps.description: Mongoose for MongoDB ODM and connect-mongo for storing sessions in MongoDB.

subSteps.title: mongoose - MongoDB ODM
subSteps.description: Elegant MongoDB object modeling for Node.js. Provides schema validation, middleware, and query building.

steps.title: express-session - Session Management
steps.description: Session middleware for Express. Manages user sessions with cookies and server-side storage.
steps.note: connect-mongo stores sessions in MongoDB instead of in-memory storage.

steps.title: cookie-parser - Parse Cookies
steps.description: Parse Cookie header and populate req.cookies. Useful for reading client-side cookies.

steps.title: Install Authentication & Security Packages
steps.description: bcrypt for password hashing and jsonwebtoken for JWT authentication.

subSteps.title: bcrypt - Password Hashing
subSteps.description: Library for hashing passwords. Never store plain-text passwords! bcrypt uses salt and cost factor for security.
subSteps.note: Higher saltRounds = more secure but slower. 10-12 is recommended.

subSteps.title: jsonwebtoken - JWT Authentication
subSteps.description: Create and verify JSON Web Tokens for stateless authentication. Alternative to sessions for APIs.

steps.title: Install Templating Packages
steps.description: EJS (Embedded JavaScript) for server-side templating with layouts support.

subSteps.title: ejs - Embedded JavaScript Templates
subSteps.description: Simple templating language that lets you generate HTML with JavaScript. Great for server-side rendering.

subSteps.title: EJS Template Example
subSteps.description: Create an EJS template file in views/index.ejs with embedded JavaScript.
subSteps.code:
Welcome, <%= user.name %>!

You are <%= user.age %> years old.

<% if (user.age >= 18) { %>

You are an adult.

<% } else { %>

You are a minor.

<% } %>
    <% ['Apple', 'Banana', 'Orange'].forEach(fruit => { %>
  • <%= fruit %>
    • <% }); %>
subSteps.note: <%= %> outputs escaped HTML, <%- %> outputs raw HTML, <% %> executes JavaScript

subSteps.title: express-ejs-layouts - Layout Support
subSteps.description: Adds layout support to EJS. Define a main layout and insert page content into it.
subSteps.note: The <%- body %> placeholder in the layout is replaced with page content.

steps.title: method-override - HTTP Method Override
steps.description: Allows browsers to use PUT and DELETE methods in forms (which only support GET and POST).
steps.note: Add ?_method=DELETE to form action. The POST request is converted to DELETE.

steps.title: Install Email Package
steps.description: Nodemailer for sending emails from your Node.js application.

subSteps.title: nodemailer - Send Emails
subSteps.description: Feature-rich module for sending emails. Supports multiple transports (SMTP, Gmail, etc.).
subSteps.note: For Gmail, enable 2FA and create an App Password in your Google Account settings.

subSteps.title: Nodemailer - Email Templates
subSteps.description: Send formatted HTML emails with templates. Great for welcome emails, password resets, etc.

steps.title: Install All Packages at Once
steps.description: Quick command to install all essential packages for a full-stack Express application.
steps.code: npm install express express-session cookie-parser dotenv method-override mongoose connect-mongo bcrypt jsonwebtoken ejs express-ejs-layouts nodemailer
steps.note: This installs all the packages covered in this cheat sheet in one command.

steps.description: Putting it all together: a complete Express server configuration with all the libraries.
